rows.title: Copy of Newspaper Publication
rows.summary: LLOYDS ENGINEERING WORKS LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication regarding Last and Final Reminder-cum-Forfeiture Notice # 2 for payment of First and Final Call on partly paid-up rights equity shares.

rows.title: Cessation
rows.summary: LLOYDS ENGINEERING WORKS LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of Mrs Bela Rajan as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company from the closure of business hours of August 31, 2026.
